activity_summary: At St Helen's you stood morning prayer. Master Thwaite turned the sand-glass twice and stopped when the prayer was said. Sir John Spencer gave two short responses from his pew and did not speak to you. Mistress Ansell came away with you across the wet close.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the two turns and left when the prayer was said.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Read the prayer, turned the sand-glass twice, and stopped.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Stood the pew with him and took him back across the close.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Gave the responses, short and cold, and did not speak to William.

facets.activity: Stood the prayer while the sand-glass turned twice

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: Morning prayer, brethren. I shall not keep you past the second glass.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: He is not speaking to me.
